summary: Bind the release to the current Yawn VPS gateway repository tip.
details: Commits 7e8139c6e3da05618e7638102a81c9ac95716c23, 8eb6f2ceb53076797c9222d14b4322a44ca10040, 416bbf27fc3f66ad74982468eb54a3e05ac47036, and 82e65ac22e2a590e366ffd9cd98c70305731d35a add sealed-product and pull-rate operator tools and move the gateway dependency to archolith-mcp-framework. The immutable Menhir installed-artifact census selects only its reviewed gateway files from this repository tip.
operator_impact: The release must use the maintenance path because a sibling release repository changed. Release authority uses the clean remote master tip and the fixed Menhir installed-artifact census.
